trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ وَاَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ وَاَنْتَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا يَبْقٰى وَلَا يَفْنٰى وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ شُكْرًا يَبْقٰى وَلَا يَفْنٰى وَاَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الْحَلِيْمُ (الْحَكِيْمُ) الْعَلِيْمُ اَسْئَلُكَ بِنُوْرِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيْمِ وَبِجَلَالِكَ الَّذِيْ لَا يُرَامُ وَبِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِيْ لَا تُقْهَرُ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِيْ وَتَرْحَمَنِيْ اِنَّكَ‌ اَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ‌۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA ANTAL A’ZEE-ZUL HAKEEMO WA ANTAL GHAFOO-RUR RAHEEMO WA ANTAL A’LIYYUL A’ZEEMO LAKAL HAMDO HAMDAN YABQAA WA LAA YAFNAA WA LA-KASH SHUKRO SHUKRAN YABQAA WA LAA YAFNAA WA ANTAL HAYYUL HALEEMUL (AL-HAKEEMUL) A’LEEMO AS-ALOKA BE-NOORE WAJHE-KAL KAREEME WA BE-JALAALE-KAL LAZEE LAA YORAA-MO WA BE-I’ZZATE-KAL LATEE LAA TUQ-HARO AN TO-SALLE-YA A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA AN TAGH-FIR-LEE WA TAR-HAMA-NEE INNA-KA ANTA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA.

trans.en: O my God! You are Exalted in Might, All-Wise! And You are All-Forgiving, Merciful! And You are the Sublime, the Supreme! A Praise belongs to You. Praise that is lasting and does not diminish. Thanks belongs to You. Thanks that is lasting and does not diminish. And You are the Living, the Wise, the All-Knowing! I ask You by the Light of Your Face the Benevolent. By Your Might that does not collapse! By Your Might that cannot be subdued. I ask You to bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s); to forgive me and have Mercy on me verily You are the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
